name: Flight price alerts: cheapest day to fly on Google Flights → Telegram

parameters.content:
## Flight price alerts: cheapest day to fly on Google Flights → Telegram
Every morning: price a route on Google Flights for each of the next 14 departure days, find the cheapest day, compare it with yesterday's and send a Telegram digest with the three cheapest dates.

**Setup**
1. Credentials → **Header Auth** named `Apify Header Auth`: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your Apify token>` (apify.com → Settings → API & Integrations). Select it in *Run Google Flights*.
2. Edit `routes` (IATA codes, `"LIS-LHR"`), `departDate` (relative, `"30 days"`) and optionally `returnDate` in *Run Google Flights*.
3. Connect your Telegram bot in *Send Telegram* and set the chat id. Threshold in *Drop ≥ threshold?* is 0 = send every day; set 5 to only hear about drops of 5 % or more.

Actor: https://apify.com/kestrel/google-flights-prices — $0.005 per itinerary row. 14 days × up to 3 itineraries = at most 42 rows = $0.21 per route per day. Status rows (the cheapest price per day) are free.
